title: Huddle spend by day
description: spend-days.json (data folder root): huddle agents' spend in USD per local day (YYYY-MM-DD, dayKey in src/usage/limit.ts) and board slug, last 60 days. Plain Record<string, Record<string, number>>; written by addHuddleSpend in src/usage/spend.ts (compact JSON, final newline, atomicWrite, read-modify-write; only costs above 0 are added). telegram-spend.json and telegram-desk-spend.json have the flatter { "YYYY-MM-DD": usd } shape: see spend-by-day.schema.json. The top level is a map keyed by day, so no other keys; the inner maps are keyed by board slug.

^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$.description: Board slug -> USD spent by that board's huddle agents that day.
